=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27680-27693 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The managed hold check in recover_stalled_issue reads only _current_wave_details_json[$issue].linked_pr and ignores _fresh_lpr_entry (lines 27453-27463, with REST fallback), so it fails open when linked_pr is missing, for example with a non-closing Refs link or a reset cache.
  WHY: A held draft or [skip ai] PR proceeds to invoke_stall_judge and can get a review dispatch, which is the behaviour the PR set out to stop. Reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21337-21372 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The resolve_merge_conflict arm of execute_stall_recovery_action has no _stall_pr_ai_hold_reason check before update-branch (line 21361) and _dispatch_review_for_conflicts (line 21364).
  WHY: When the stall judge returns resolve_merge_conflict for a held PR, the arm still pushes and dispatches review. Only the retrigger_review arm re-checks. Reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36002-36018 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The standalone conflict sweep hold check runs before the S_MERGEABLE_STATE dirty filter, so clean held PRs log STANDALONE_CONFLICT_STUCK ... reason=pr_ai_hold on every tick.
  WHY: Log consumers count clean held PRs as stuck conflicts. The existing capacity-wait skip has the same ordering, so this is log hygiene only. Reviewers rated this NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23472-23507 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The _stall_pr_ai_hold_reason comment says a payload without the fields fails open, but the jq filter defaults a missing state to "open", so the comment diverges from the implementation for partial payloads.
  WHY: Runtime behaviour is correct, but the misleading comment could lead maintainers to weaken the guard. Reviewer rated this NIT, mapped here to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27680-27693 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hold check in recover_stalled_issue reads only the wave-details linked_pr and ignores _fresh_lpr_entry (lines 27453-27463), so it fails open. The flow reaches invoke_stall_judge at line 27707, and the resolve_merge_conflict arm (lines 21337-21372) has no hold check.
  WHY: A held PR can still get update-branch and _dispatch_review_for_conflicts. Suggested fix: use _fresh_lpr_entry first, and add the hold check in the resolve_merge_conflict arm.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36005-36009 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The hold check runs before the dirty filter at lines 36011-36018, so clean held PRs log STANDALONE_CONFLICT_STUCK ... reason=pr_ai_hold on every tick.
  WHY: Log consumers would count clean held PRs as stuck conflicts. Moving the check after the dirty continue fixes it.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2): add the hold check in the resolve_merge_conflict arm after line 21347; use _fresh_lpr_entry at line 27682. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: A held PR fails the hold check, reaches the judge, and can get resolve_merge_conflict (lines 21337-21372) with no hold check.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21337-21372 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The resolve_merge_conflict arm calls update-branch (line 21361) and _dispatch_review_for_conflicts (line 21364) with no hold check on pr_json, although the payload is already fetched at line 21347.
  WHY: A held PR can still get update-branch and a conflict-resolver dispatch. This is a fourth bypass vector.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36002-36009 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The sweep hold check runs before the dirty filter at lines 36011-36018, so held clean PRs log STANDALONE_CONFLICT_STUCK on every tick.
  WHY: Log consumers will count every held PR as a stuck conflict.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23472-23507 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The helper comment says a payload without the fields fails open, but the jq filter defaults a missing state to "open", so the comment diverges from the implementation for partial payloads.
  WHY: The comment could mislead maintainers into weakening the guard. Runtime behaviour is correct.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3): add the hold check in the resolve_merge_conflict arm; align line 27680 with _fresh_lpr_entry; move the sweep hold check after the dirty filter at line 36018. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
